name: Weather alerts
author: Brian Busch
description: Active NWS alerts, NOAA geomagnetic storm alerts, Kp and the national severe-storm, rainfall, fire, winter and river outlooks for your Omarchy weather location. A bar glyph, a panel, and one desktop notification per new alert. NWS data covers the United States.

barWidget.description: Active weather alerts and outlooks; click for the alert list, outlooks and Kp

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Notify once for each new alert, and again when it escalates or changes. Alerts are still listed when off.

schema.label: Refresh (minutes)
schema.description: How often alerts are fetched while the shell is running. Outlooks are refreshed at most every 30 minutes.
